attchmntText: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet as Intimation regarding Q2FY27 and H1FY27 Earnings Update Call on November 18, 2026 at 04:00 P.M. (IST).
voiceSummary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has scheduled a virtual conference call for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. IST. The call will discuss the company's Q2FY27 and H1FY27 earnings update for the period ended September 30, 2026, and the future business outlook. Mr. Yash Bhuva from the Senior Management Team will represent the company. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. Interested participants can join via dial-in numbers or the Diamond Pass link provided in the announcement. The event is open to all interested persons.

attchmntText: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited approved proposals to increase authorized share capital to Rs. 68,50,00,000 divided into 6,85,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each, subject to member approval. The board also approved sub-dividing shares from Rs. 10 to Rs. 5 each and issuing bonus shares at a 5:1 ratio, capitalizing Rs. 52,50,00,000 from reserves. These actions are pending shareholder approval via postal ballot with a cut-off date of November 13, 2026. Mr. Nayan Pitroda is appointed as scrutinizer. Outstanding convertible warrants will be adjusted to entitle holders to 12 shares of Rs. 5 each upon conversion. The record date for entitlements will be intimated separately.

attchmntText: Sheetal Cool Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The board meeting was held on 07 November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 6,531.27 lakhs. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 323.80 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 3.08. For the half-year, revenue from operations was Rs. 19,795.46 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 1,022.75 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 9.74. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 stood at Rs. 30,933.21 lakhs. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report. The company noted a migration and subsequent reversion of its accounting software.
